activities.main_competence: 1.0  Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts, theories and principles of theatre arts
activities.specific_competence: 1.1  Demonstrate an understanding of the development of theatre arts and its major trends
activities.learning_activity: (a)  Describe the major trends in the development of theatre worldwide (naturalism, realism, symbolism, expressionism and theatre of the absurd)
suggested_methods: ICT-based learning: Guide students to use mobile application and web-based learning to search on the major trends in the development of theatre worldwide
Think-ink-pair-share: Guide students into collaborative learning in answering questions based on the major trends in the development of theatre worldwide
Snow-balling: Guide students to summarize the major trends in the development of theatre worldwide
activities.assessment_criteria: Major trends in the development of theatre worldwide well described
suggested_resources: Videos of theatre arts movements and trends

activities.main_competence: 1.0  Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts, theories and principles of theatre arts

suggested_methods: ICT-based learning: Guide students to use mobile application and web-based learning to search the major trends in the development of theatre in Africa
Case study: Organize students into conducting depth examination and analysis to distinguish theatre for social change events from other events and situation
activities.assessment_criteria: Trends in the development of theatre in Africa well described
suggested_resources: Videos of theatre arts movement and trends

activities.assessment_criteria: The emergence and development of scriptwriting for stage, film, radio and television well explained
